My mate did meet an early grave

8df80424-3bd9-4982-ad79-e55d9ba3b43d.name: Wall of Wood
8df80424-3bd9-4982-ad79-e55d9ba3b43d.flavorText: Everybody knows that to ward off trouble, you knock on wood. But usually it’s better to make a wall out of the wood and let trouble do the knocking.
